_comment: Bubble columns may stand in the abyss.
**Vanilla's tag names the fluid `minecraft:water` directly, not `#minecraft:water`** -- so deep water
is excluded from it however thoroughly it is water everywhere else, and a magma block at the bottom of
an abyss makes no whirlpool at all. `BubbleColumnBlock.canOccupy` reads this tag and then asks for a
`LiquidBlock` source of at least eight, both of which `DeepWaterBlock` already answers.
The general rule this is an instance of: anywhere vanilla says `Blocks.WATER` or `Fluids.WATER` by
identity instead of `#minecraft:water`, deep water stops being water. See design SS7.1.2.
